title: Travel and Transport
description: Membicarakan transportasi dan perjalanan, menceritakan pengalaman dengan past continuous dan past simple (when/while), memakai preposisi gerak, serta memesan hotel dan menjelaskan masalah perjalanan.
objectives: Menggunakan kosakata transportasi, bandara, dan hotel
Membentuk past continuous untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu

lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Cara bepergian
Untuk menyebutkan **cara** bepergian, gunakan **by + kendaraan** tanpa *a/the*:

| Pola | Contoh |
| --- | --- |
| by bus / train / plane / car / taxi / boat | *I go to work by train.* |
| **on foot** (jalan kaki) | *She goes to school on foot.* |

Perhatikan: ✗ *by the taxi*, ✗ *by foot*. Jika ada kata kepemilikan, gunakan *in/on*: *in my car*, *on the 7:15 bus*.

### Kata kerja transportasi
| Kata kerja | Arti | Past |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **catch** a bus/train | naik, mengejar (bus/kereta) | caught |
| **miss** a bus/flight | ketinggalan | missed |
| **get on / get off** a bus, train, plane | naik / turun | got on / got off |
| **get into / get out of** a car, taxi | masuk / keluar (mobil) | got into / got out of |
| **take** a taxi / the bus | naik (taksi/bus) | took |

Gunakan **get on/off** untuk kendaraan besar (bus, kereta, pesawat) dan **get into/out of** untuk mobil dan taksi.

### Di bandara
| English | Indonesia |
| --- | --- |
| check in | lapor diri, check-in |
| boarding pass | pas naik pesawat |
| passport | paspor |
| luggage / baggage | bagasi, barang bawaan |
| gate | gerbang keberangkatan |
| departures / arrivals | keberangkatan / kedatangan |
| delayed | tertunda, terlambat |
| cancelled | dibatalkan |
| land / take off | mendarat / lepas landas |

### Urutan di bandara
*First, we **checked in** and dropped off our luggage. Then we went through security. After that, we waited at **gate** 12. Finally, we **got on** the plane. Our flight was **delayed** by an hour, but we **landed** safely.*

### Catatan
*Luggage* dan *baggage* adalah kata benda **tak terhitung**: *a lot of luggage*, *two pieces of luggage* — bukan ✗ *two luggages*.

lessons.title: Past Continuous: I Was Travelling
lessons.summary: Membentuk past continuous untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu.
objectives: Menggunakan past continuous untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu dan untuk latar cerita
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Apa itu past continuous?
**Past continuous** menggambarkan kegiatan yang **sedang berlangsung** pada suatu waktu di masa lalu. Dalam bahasa Indonesia biasanya memakai kata *sedang*.

*At eight o'clock last night, I **was having** dinner.* (Jam delapan tadi malam, saya sedang makan malam.)

Kegiatan makan malam sudah dimulai sebelum jam 8 dan masih berlangsung pada jam 8.

### Pola
Gabungkan **was/were** (Unit 1) dengan **verb-ing** (present continuous, A1):

| Bentuk | Pola | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Positif | subject + **was/were** + verb-ing | *They were waiting for the bus.* |
| Negatif | subject + **wasn't/weren't** + verb-ing | *I wasn't sleeping.* |
| Pertanyaan | **Was/Were** + subject + verb-ing? | *Were you working at 9 p.m.?* |
| Wh- | Wh- + **was/were** + subject + verb-ing? | *What were you doing?* |
| Short answer | Yes, I was. / No, they weren't. | |

Aturan *was/were* sama dengan Unit 1: **I/he/she/it → was**, **you/we/they → were**. Aturan ejaan *-ing* sama dengan A1: *make → making, swim → swimming, lie → lying*.

### Dua penggunaan utama
**1. Kegiatan pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu**
- *At 6 a.m. yesterday, I was driving to the airport.*
- *What were you doing at midnight?*

**2. Latar (background) dalam cerita**
Penulis memakai past continuous untuk menggambarkan suasana di awal cerita:
- *It was a beautiful morning. The sun **was shining** and the birds **were singing**. We **were sitting** on the train...*

### Present continuous vs past continuous
| Present continuous | Past continuous |
| --- | --- |
| *I **am** reading now.* | *I **was** reading at 10 p.m. yesterday.* |
| *They **are** travelling.* | *They **were** travelling last week.* |

### Kata kerja yang jarang memakai -ing
Kata kerja keadaan seperti *know, like, want, need, have* (= punya) biasanya **tidak** dipakai dalam bentuk continuous: ✗ *I was knowing him.* ✓ *I knew him.*

lessons.title: Past Continuous and Past Simple: When and While
lessons.summary: Menggabungkan kegiatan panjang (past continuous) dan kejadian singkat (past simple) dengan when dan while.
objectives: Menggunakan past continuous untuk kegiatan panjang dan past simple untuk kejadian yang menyela
Memilih when atau while dengan tepat
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Kegiatan panjang disela kejadian singkat
Dalam cerita, sering ada kegiatan yang **sedang berlangsung** lalu **disela** oleh kejadian singkat.

*I **was walking** to the station **when** I **saw** an accident.*

| Bagian | Tense | Fungsi |
| --- | --- | --- |
| was walking | past continuous | kegiatan panjang (latar) |
| saw | past simple | kejadian singkat yang menyela |

Bayangkan garis waktu: kegiatan *walking* adalah garis panjang, dan *saw* adalah titik di tengah garis itu.

### When dan while
| Kata | Biasanya diikuti | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **when** | past simple (kejadian singkat) | *I was sleeping **when** the phone **rang**.* |
| **while** | past continuous (kegiatan panjang) | ***While** I **was sleeping**, the phone rang.* |

Keduanya berarti *ketika/saat*, tetapi **while** menekankan durasi (*selama sedang...*).

### Urutan dan tanda koma
Klausa when/while boleh di depan atau di belakang. Jika di **depan**, pakai **koma**:
- *While we were waiting for the bus, it started raining.*
- *It started raining while we were waiting for the bus.*

### Dua kegiatan bersamaan
Jika dua kegiatan panjang terjadi **bersamaan**, keduanya memakai past continuous dengan **while**:
- *While I was cooking, my husband was cleaning the car.*

### Rangkaian kejadian
Jika kejadian terjadi **berurutan** (satu setelah yang lain), pakai past simple untuk semuanya:
- *When the bus arrived, we got on.* (Bus datang, lalu kami naik.)

Bandingkan:
- *When I arrived, they **were having** dinner.* (Mereka sudah mulai makan sebelum saya datang.)
- *When I arrived, they **had** dinner.* (Saya datang, lalu mereka makan.)

### Kata kerja tidak beraturan baru
*ring → **rang***, *fall → **fell***, *break → **broke***, *hear → **heard***, *lose → **lost***.

lessons.title: Prepositions of Movement
lessons.summary: Menjelaskan arah gerakan dengan across, along, through, over, past, into, out of, up, down.
objectives: Menggunakan preposisi gerak untuk menjelaskan rute
Membedakan across, along, through, dan past
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Preposisi gerak
Di A1 kamu belajar preposisi **tempat** (*in, on, under, next to*). Preposisi **gerak** (*movement*) menjelaskan **arah** seseorang atau sesuatu bergerak. Biasanya dipakai setelah kata kerja gerak: *go, walk, run, drive, fly, swim, jump, climb*.

| Preposisi | Arti | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **across** | menyeberangi (dari satu sisi ke sisi lain) | *walk across the road* |
| **along** | menyusuri (mengikuti garis) | *walk along the beach* |
| **through** | menembus, melewati bagian dalam | *drive through the tunnel* |
| **over** | melewati di atas | *fly over the mountains* |
| **under** | lewat di bawah | *swim under the bridge* |
| **past** | melewati (tanpa berhenti) | *go past the bank* |
| **into** | masuk ke dalam | *walk into the hotel* |
| **out of** | keluar dari | *get out of the car* |
| **up / down** | naik / turun | *climb up the hill*, *run down the stairs* |
| **towards** | menuju ke arah | *walk towards the gate* |
| **around** | mengelilingi | *walk around the lake* |

### Across, through, along — apa bedanya?
- **across** = dari satu sisi ke sisi lain permukaan datar: *across the street, across the river, across the field*.
- **through** = masuk dari satu ujung dan keluar dari ujung lain, seperti ada **dinding/sisi** di sekitar: *through the forest, through the tunnel, through the door*.
- **along** = mengikuti sesuatu yang panjang: *along the river, along the coast*.

### In vs into
- *in* = posisi (diam): *The cat is in the box.*
- *into* = gerakan masuk: *The cat jumped into the box.*

### Memberi petunjuk arah
Preposisi gerak sangat berguna bersama imperatif (A1):
*Go **out of** the station and walk **along** the river. Go **past** the post office and walk **across** the bridge. The hotel is on your left.*

### Di masa lalu
*We drove **through** a long tunnel and then **over** a high bridge.*

lessons.title: Hotels and Travel Problems
lessons.summary: Memesan kamar hotel, menjelaskan masalah perjalanan, dan menceritakan pengalaman perjalanan.
objectives: Memesan kamar hotel dengan ungkapan sederhana
Menceritakan pengalaman perjalanan dengan past simple dan past continuous
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, tulis cerita perjalanan, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Memesan kamar hotel
| Tamu | Resepsionis |
| --- | --- |
| *Do you have any rooms available for tonight?* | *Yes, we do. / Sorry, we're fully booked.* |
| *Can I book a double room for three nights?* | *Of course. What's your name, please?* |
| *How much is it per night?* | *It's 450,000 rupiah per night.* |
| *Is breakfast included?* | *Yes, breakfast is from 6 to 10.* |
| *What time is check-out?* | *Check-out is at 12 noon.* |

### Jenis kamar
- **single room** — untuk satu orang
- **double room** — satu tempat tidur besar untuk dua orang
- **twin room** — dua tempat tidur terpisah

### Masalah perjalanan (travel problems)
| Masalah | Arti |
| --- | --- |
| My luggage didn't arrive. | Bagasi saya tidak sampai. |
| Our flight was cancelled. | Penerbangan kami dibatalkan. |
| We missed our connection. | Kami ketinggalan penerbangan lanjutan. |
| The air conditioning isn't working. | AC-nya tidak berfungsi. |
| The room was dirty / noisy. | Kamarnya kotor / berisik. |
| I lost my passport. | Saya kehilangan paspor. |

### Menceritakan pengalaman perjalanan
Cerita perjalanan yang baik menggabungkan semua tense yang sudah dipelajari:
1. **Latar** (past continuous): *We were travelling to Lombok for my cousin's wedding.*
2. **Masalah** (past simple + when/while): *While we were waiting at the airport, they cancelled our flight.*
3. **Apa yang kamu lakukan** (past simple + sequencers): *First, we went to the airline desk. Then they gave us a hotel room.*
4. **Akhir dan perasaan** (was/were): *Finally, we arrived a day late, but we were happy.*

### Mengeluh dengan sopan
Saat ada masalah di hotel, mulai dengan **Excuse me** atau **I'm sorry, but...**:
- *Excuse me, the shower in room 304 isn't working. Can you send someone, please?*
- *I'm sorry, but my room is very noisy. Can I change rooms?*

dialogue.text: OK. Three nights, until Friday. Breakfast is included.

options: Three nights. We're leaving on Friday.
questions.explanation: Resepsionis menanyakan berapa malam, jadi tamu menjawab jumlah malam dan kapan pergi (present continuous untuk rencana).

questions.prompt: Write about a journey you remember (real or imaginary). Where were you going? What problem happened? What did you do? Use the past continuous at least twice and when or while at least once.
questions.explanation: Gunakan past continuous untuk latar (We were travelling...), past simple untuk kejadian (the bus broke down), dan sequencers untuk urutan.

questions.prompt: Read the hotel review. What happened while the writer was sleeping?
questions.context: We stayed at the Blue Lagoon Hotel for two nights. When we arrived, our room wasn't ready, so we waited in the café for an hour. The room was big and clean. But on the first night, while we were sleeping, the air conditioning stopped working, and it was really hot. The staff were very helpful. They gave us a new room the next morning.
options: The staff gave them a new room.
questions.explanation: Teks: while we were sleeping, the air conditioning stopped working.

questions.prompt: Match each problem with the best solution.

pairs.right: Go to the lost baggage desk.
Ask the airline for another flight.

pairs.left: The shower in my room isn't working.

questions.explanation: Bagasi hilang → lost baggage desk; penerbangan batal → minta penerbangan lain; shower rusak → telepon resepsionis; ketinggalan bus → naik taksi.

questions.prompt: Join the two sentences with when.
questions.sentence: We were checking in. The fire alarm rang.
questions.cue: Begin with: We were checking in ...
answers: We were checking in when the fire alarm rang.
questions.explanation: Kegiatan panjang (were checking in) + when + kejadian singkat (rang).

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the correct option: While I ___ along the beach, I found a beautiful shell.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: While + kegiatan panjang → past continuous. I → was walking.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Complete with the past simple or past continuous of the verbs in brackets.
unitTestQuestions.text: It ___ (rain) when our plane ___ (land) in Medan.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Hujan sedang berlangsung → was raining. Pesawat mendarat (kejadian singkat) → landed.

unitTestQuestions.text: The bus went ___ the long tunnel and then drove ___ the hill to the hotel at the top.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Melewati terowongan → through. Naik bukit ke hotel di puncak → up.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Find the mistake in the sentence.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Everyone diperlakukan sebagai subjek tunggal, jadi memakai was clapping.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Match the verbs with the words that go with them.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: get on the bus (kendaraan besar), get out of the taxi (mobil), miss a flight (ketinggalan pesawat), book a hotel room (memesan kamar).

unitTestQuestions.source: Kamu sedang apa jam delapan tadi malam?
answers: What were you doing at eight o'clock last night?
What were you doing at 8 o'clock last night?
What were you doing at eight last night?
What were you doing at 8 p.m. last night?
What were you doing at 8 last night?
At eight o'clock last night, what were you doing?
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Sedang apa (lampau) → What were you doing? Jam delapan tadi malam = at eight o'clock last night.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the best word: Please show your passport and your ___ at the gate before you get on the plane.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Dokumen untuk naik pesawat yang ditunjukkan di gerbang = boarding pass.
